title: Asymmetric fractional coupled magnetizable piezoelectric beams with infinite viscoelastic memory: polynomial decay and sharpness of the decay rate
summary: This paper studies the long-time dynamics of a coupled hyperbolic system for magnetizable piezoelectric beams with infinite viscoelastic memory. Memory dissipation is characterized by $A^α$, the fractional power of a positive self-adjoint operator $A$ with $α\in[0,1)$. An asymmetric fractional magnetoelectric coupling is adopted: the mechanical-to-magnetic coupling uses integer-order operator $A$, while the magnetic feedback to mechanics is governed by fractional operator $A^β$ ($β\in[0,1)$).
